slides.title: Web Scraping
slides.content:
# Beautiful Soup 🍲

Parse HTML/XML!

```python
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests

html = requests.get('https://example.com').text
soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')

# Find elements
title = soup.title.text
links = soup.find_all('a')
```

slides.title: Selecting Elements
slides.content:
# Selectors 🎯

```python
# By tag
soup.find('h1')
soup.find_all('p')

# By class
soup.find('div', class_='container')

# By id
soup.find(id='main')

# CSS selectors
soup.select('div.card h2')
soup.select('#header a')
```
